decision: Model the ordinary Normal chain at A0 as five admitted inputs with packet groups [Melee1], [Melee2, Melee3], [Melee4], [Melee5, Melee6], [Melee7, Melee8]. All eight source rows use native ATK ratios and Psyche metadata. The native source and Neverness display ratios agree at every published level 1-9. HP coefficients on other actions are outside this Normal adapter.
hypotheses: A different admitted ability or field exit resets the chain; a same-actor switch does not.
A gap greater than 2 seconds between input starts resets the chain; exactly 2 seconds continues.
The ordered packets within a multi-hit stage deliver at the primary impact timestamp; animation intervals and travel remain unresolved.
independent_oracles: At 1000 ATK and the level-80 target DEF factor 0.5, the level-1 eight-hit chain is 216.5 + 148.5 + 180 + 385.5 + 141.5 + 166 + 136.5 + 401.5 = 1776 damage.
At the same conditions, the level-8 chain is 371 + 254.5 + 308.5 + 660.5 + 242.5 + 284.5 + 234 + 688 = 3043.5 damage.
At purchased level 8 with resonance_3 active, the projected level-9 chain is 400.5 + 275 + 333 + 713.5 + 262 + 307.5 + 252.5 + 743 = 3287 damage.
checks: Focused native tests verify all packet effects, exact per-hit damage, Psyche/category metadata, chain looping, resonance level projection, and invariance to Fadia HP, current HP, and DEF.
The normal-chain source verifier compares all nine published ratio levels to the eight frozen native ATK arrays.
Public five-input rotation checks use CLI/WASM/Worker parity and exact damage totals; strict mode requires the matching chain hypothesis.
